anchor_reason: Patch 34 (row 2, column 6 of the 224 px view) holds the bulldog's black nose at the centre of its face; the dog is the larger animal, and patch 35 beside it holds an eye.
what: run 2's teacher (the rule's tokens) and student (the loss's tokens) of the final envelope on the followed image's 224 px view (images.json views.224); every index is row * 14 + column

dino.input: the decoded int8 keys of the keys480 file (exactly the page's numbers), under the key rule
dino.not_replicated: run_decoder's bilateral post-processing and its resize of the masks to native size

selfpatch.input: the decoded int8 keys of the keys480 file (exactly the page's numbers), under the key rule
selfpatch.not_replicated: run_decoder's bilateral post-processing and its resize of the masks to native size

con2.input: the decoded int8 keys of the keys480 file (exactly the page's numbers), under the key rule
con2.not_replicated: run_decoder's bilateral post-processing and its resize of the masks to native size

members.pos: each anchor's positives, the most similar first (the first k are its top k)
members.neg: each anchor's negatives, the least similar first
members.pos_uncapped: each anchor's union of top k and threshold part before the cap of 24
members.neg_uncapped: each anchor's candidates at or below tau_lo that are not its positives, before the cap
members.infonce: L_i of every anchor at tau 0.1, 0.2 and 0.3 (0 for an anchor without a negative) and their mean over the crop
members.anchor_cos_student_teacher: cos(student token of the anchor, teacher token j) for j = 0 to 195
members.anchor_terms: l_p at tau 0.2 for each positive p of the anchor, in pos order
members.anchor_shares: for each positive p of the anchor (pos order), the softmax shares at tau 0.2 of [s_p, s_n for n in neg order]
members.sim_teacher: float32 196 x 196, the teacher's cosines, the diagonal stored as -1e9
members.anchor_grad: float32 384, autograd: the gradient of the anchor's mean InfoNCE at tau 0.2 with respect to its unit student token, through the normalisation (so tangent to the unit sphere)
members.anchor_pull: float32 384, -(1/tau) sum_p w_p (1 - a_p) t_p, projected on the tangent plane
members.anchor_push: float32 384, (1/tau) sum_p w_p sum_n a_n t_n, projected on the tangent plane
members.attention_last: float32 3 x 6 x 196 x 196: the last backbone block's attention (heads x queries x keys) of dino, selfpatch and con2 (attention_last_models); these backbones have no CLS token
members.attention_rows_con2: float32 12 x 6 x 196: con2's attention row of the anchor in every block and head
members.attention_last_original_dino: float32 6 x 197 x 197: the original DINO network (with its CLS token, index 0, and its final norm) on the same view, last block
members.class_attention: float32 2 x 2 x 6 x 197: the aggregation head's class token attending over itself (index 0) and the 196 final-block tokens, in its two class-attention blocks, for selfpatch and con2 (class_attention_models)
members.decoder: per model, maskcut_core_v2's stages on the decoded keys of the keys480 file after the key rule at the frozen configuration (tau 0.2)
